title: Delaware State Summer Youth Employment Program
sponsor: Delaware Department of Labor, Division of Employment and Training
description: This state program gives young people a summer job for about ten weeks between June and August. You get real work experience and learn what employers expect. Contact the Division of Employment and Training through the page to ask about applying.

title: Jerome R. Lewis Legislative Fellows Program
sponsor: University of Delaware, Biden School Institute for Public Administration
who_text: Full-time master's students, or juniors and seniors with a 3.4 GPA or higher, at the University of Delaware or Delaware State University
description: Fellows work with Delaware lawmakers on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays from January 12 to June 30, 2027. You do nonpartisan research and help staff legislative committees.
